svg.aria-label: The plan skill. Boxes: The ledger folder named from the entry's slug (a step of the session); plan.md drafted: the goal, the gate, the rulings and the step list, each check asked whether it could pass without the goal (a step of the session); A gate with no count (stop); The drafted step list (stop); orchestrator-state.md written, its configuration block filled (a step of the session); agents/briefs/ and agents/reviews/ made, each with a .gitkeep (a step of the session); The opening commit, naming its paths (a step of the session).
